text: . You just lost your tablet you just received and are in a bad mood. You want to know the tracking number of the order, and if the agent can help you refund or reorder the tablet. (You know it's a long shot, but you want to try). If not, cancel the charger you just bought, because it goes with the tablet... Also cancel the boot and keep the kettle (if not possible, do not do anything on that order), and return the sneaker.
zh: 你刚刚丢失了你刚收到的平板电脑，心情很不好。你想知道订单的追踪号，并且想知道客服能否帮你退款或重新订购平板电脑。（你知道希望渺茫，但你想试试）。如果不行，取消你刚买的充电器，因为它和平板电脑是一套... 另外，取消靴子，保留水壶（如果不可能，不要在那个订单上做任何事），并且退货。(#W1234567, 平板电脑, #I7890123, 充电器, #I4567890, 靴子, #I1234567)
